title: Figure 2: Subsonic Flow Past a Projectile (boundary layers, Strouhal eddies, wake)
description: Schematic of a green bullet-shaped projectile in flow moving right to left, with streamlines bending around it. Labels identify 'Boundary Layers', 'Streamlines', 'Strouhal Eddies or Vortices', 'Turbulent Wake', 'Projectile' and 'Direction of Flow', with curved arrows depicting vortices shed behind the body.
